- Wait a moment! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please come back later -
- after you put some items into kafra storage. -

scripts.speaker: Old Pharmacist
scripts.text:
Ummmm...
What brings you here...?
Make Potion
Talk.
Mixing Information
Cancel

scripts.speaker: Old Pharmacist
scripts.text:
Why are you carrying these so many!
Don't be greedy, carry only as much you need!

scripts.speaker: Old Pharmacist
scripts.text:
You are too heavy to receive potions from me...
Go store some items in your storage first!

scripts.speaker: Old Pharmacist
scripts.text: You have all the stuff ready, right? Which one would you like?
Red Potion.
Orange Potion.
Yellow Potion.
White Potion.
Blue Potion.
Green Potion.
Actually, I don't want anything.

scripts.speaker: Old Pharmacist
scripts.text:
You rascal! What did you expect?! Coming here with nothing. Tsk!
Get lost!

scripts.speaker: Old Pharmacist
scripts.text: How many?
Make as many as I can.
I want to choose an amount.
Actually, I don't want anything.

scripts.speaker: Old Pharmacist
scripts.text: You rascal! You don't even have all the materials and you want me to make you potions?!

scripts.speaker: Old Pharmacist
scripts.text: Then pick a number below 100. If you don't want any, just enter '0'. With the materials you have, you can make about {0} potions.

scripts.speaker: Old Pharmacist
scripts.text: Make up your mind, will you?!

scripts.speaker: Old Pharmacist
scripts.text: Are you deaf? I said less than 100!

scripts.speaker: Old Pharmacist
scripts.text: You rascal! You don't even have all the materials and you want me to make you potions?!

scripts.speaker: Old Pharmacist
scripts.text:
What?!
Grrr...
Bleh!
Get lost!

scripts.speaker: Old Pharmacist
scripts.text: Here you go. It's all done so you can take it. But remember! Abusing medicine is not good.

scripts.speaker: Old Pharmacist
scripts.text:
What?!
Grrr...
Bleh!
Get lost!

scripts.speaker: Old Pharmacist
scripts.text: With medicine, you can increase a person's ability to regenerate. But, they're only good up to a point. *Sigh* I'm starting to think of the days when I was young. I must be getting old.

scripts.speaker: Old Pharmacist
scripts.text: Anyways, a potion is merely a potion. Nothing more and nothing less.

scripts.speaker: Old Pharmacist
scripts.text:
Hrrrmm...
You young ones can be quite annoying. But, since you asked, I'll explain.

scripts.speaker: Old Pharmacist
scripts.text: Herbs work well by themselves, but if you use my special techniques and skills to make potions out of them, the effect is much much greater.

scripts.speaker: Old Pharmacist
scripts.text: If you ask eagerly and politely, I will make them for you. But, not for free... Don't worry though, I only charge a small fee, so it's not that expensive.
